request.spec:
A paste box takes lines of name,amount,date,note (the note may hold commas; the date may be
blank for the sheet's today; the note may be absent) and adds a DRAFT claim per line, in order,
for the named person (the name must be on the sheet, matched as names are compared). Every line is
checked first with exactly the claim form's rules: if any line fails, an error shows on the box
and nothing is added; otherwise every claim is added and written as CLAIM_ADDED. Show how many
were added.
request.prompt:

A paste box takes lines of name,amount,date,note (the note may hold commas; the date may be
blank for the sheet's today; the note may be absent) and adds a DRAFT claim per line, in order,
for the named person (the name must be on the sheet, matched as names are compared). Every line is

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The paste box is in and works: `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**How it behaves**
- Each line is `name,amount,date,note`. A line only needs the first three fields, so `Ada,1.00,,` is fine. The note is everything after the third comma, so it can contain commas (`a, b`). A blank date means the sheet's today. Blank lines are skipped.
- Names are matched the way the app already compares them, ignoring spaces at the ends and letter case (` ADA ` finds Ada). A name that isn't on the sheet refuses the whole paste.
- Each line is checked with the claim form's own rules by reusing the existing claim-adding code. That covers amounts with more than two decimals, negative amounts (the paste has no way to say which claim one corrects), dates in a closed period and dates after a person retired.
- The whole paste is one transaction. If any line fails, everything rolls back: no claims are added, no audit lines are written, and the error shows on the box. If all lines pass, each claim is written as `CLAIM_ADDED` in order and the box shows the count added.

**Changes**
- **Server:** a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{id}/claims/paste`, in `ClaimController.java`. It is backed by a new `PasteClaimsService.java`, plus `PasteClaimsException.java`, which returns a 422 when a line can't be read or names someone not on the sheet.
- **Front end:** the paste box in `people.ts`, with the test ids `paste-claims`, `paste-submit`, `paste-added` and `paste-error`. Editing the box or pressing the button again clears the old error and count, as AGENTS.md requires.

No database change was needed.

When a paste is refused, the error doesn't say which line failed. The server builds a line-numbered reason, but the app's current settings don't send that text to the browser, so you only see the general message.
